This is just one layer of the ritual. King Solomons Temple up next... 

#schizomaxxing #patternrecognition #sirius
video_overlay_text_observed: Talking-head with inserted images and on-screen text cards naming dates and numbers.
audio_content_summary: An astrotheological reading of September 11: the date as a Sirius-linked occult holiday, the Pentagon groundbreaking of 1941, the 1990 "new world order" address, the claim that the 911 emergency number launched on September 11, 1987, and the death of Sirius, the Port Authority explosives dog, read as a burnt offering to Baal via wordplay on his name, badge number and breed.
implied_frame: Framing: the date and its associated numbers were chosen for an occult ritual. Checked here: the Pentagon broke ground on September 11, 1941; Bush used the phrase "a new world order" in a September 11, 1990 address on the Persian Gulf crisis; the 911 emergency number did not launch on September 11, 1987 — the first call was February 16, 1968, and 1987 is the year coverage reached about half the population; Sirius was a real Port Authority explosives dog, shield 17, the only dog killed that day. Not asserted here: the Sirius-star calendar reading, the tarot and reversed-word links, or that any of it indicates ritual design. The Rumsfeld $2.3 trillion statement referenced in passing is documented separately.
